gates.location: north side, facing Randol Mill Rd
southeast corner, closest to shuttle drop-off

transit.detail: runs every 10 min to Dallas & Fort Worth downtown hubs from Lot 6, first 90 min after final whistle
shuttle from Lot 6 to CentrePort station, trains every 20 min
official pickup zone Lot 14, expect 30-45 min wait and surge pricing right after the match

faq.a: Clear bags up to 30x30x15 cm only. Small clutches allowed. No backpacks.
No re-entry once you pass the turnstiles.
Free water refill stations on every concourse near first aid points. One sealed plastic bottle up to 500 ml allowed in.
Step-free access at every gate. Elevators near sections 108, 225, 320 and 440. Wheelchair seating on every level; staff at any Fan Help kiosk can assist. Sensory room near section 244.
Multi-faith room on the Main Concourse near section 240, open from gates until 1 hour after the match.
First aid stations near sections 115, 230, 330 and 445. Dial staff at any Fan Help kiosk for emergencies.
Guest Services at Gate A and Gate K, or report online at the venue website after the event.
The whole stadium is smoke-free, including e-cigarettes. No re-entry, so no smoke breaks outside.
Gates open 3 hours before kickoff. Arrive at least 90 minutes early; security peaks 60-30 minutes before kickoff.
